title: fix(service-messaging)!: sys_notification_template.channel accepts only email and sms, the channels that read a template
body:
Fixes #24924

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changes

`sys_notification_template.channel` accepts only `email` and `sms`, the two channels that read a template row. This is execution card ② of the maintainer's ruling D on #24770.

- **Write refusal.** The object declares one `format` validation rule, `channel_renders_template`, whose pattern is built from a single `TEMPLATE_CHANNELS` constant (`email`, `sms`). A save naming any other channel answers `VALIDATION_FAILED`, served `400`, with one field error on `channel` (`invalid_format`). Its message points in-app content to an email template: "Channel must be email or sms: only those channels use a notification template, and a template for any other channel is never sent. For in-app (inbox) content, write an email template (email_template) and name it in the notify step's template; email and the inbox both render it."
- **Copy.** The object description, the `all` view's empty state, and the `channel` and `subject` help now say which channels use a row and that the inbox never does. They are translated in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. The es-ES and ja-JP leaves for those keys were untranslated English fills; they are translations now, so their provenance hashes drop.
- **Docs.** In `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`, the "SMS text customisation & localisation" paragraph loses the retired-seed sentence. It now states what PR #24930 made true: the auth SMS row is read in `tenancy.defaultOrgId()`. Under `single` that is the Default Organization's row. Under `isolated` and `group` no row is read and the built-in text is sent.
- **Not touched:** `packages/spec/**` (the `script.config.template` tombstone half belongs to #24965 in the spec lane), `template-renderer.ts`, and the channels.

## Route: a `format` rule, not a `select` (measured)

The dispatch preferred the field's own options plus the platform's select validation, if that refuses loudly. I measured the `select` spelling on a real ObjectQL with SqlDriver on this branch, with `channel` as `Field.select(['email','sms'])`. The scratch test is not committed.

| Write | `select` options | `format` rule (shipped) |
|---|---|---|
| insert `inbox` | Refused with the generic "Channel must be one of: email, sms" (`invalid_option`). The message catalog is keyed by message key only, so no per-field sentence can carry the email-template pointer. | Refused with the prescription above |
| insert `inbox` carrying an import's `keptOptionValues` | **Accepted**: `channel: inbox` is stored | Refused |
| Setup edit of a stored `inbox` row | Newly refused. At the console pin `616df6598`, objectui's `SelectField` clears an out-of-set value on load (cascade clear plus `isValueStillOffered`). The diff-only save then sends `channel: null`, which I measured refused as `required` ("Channel is required and cannot be cleared"). | Unchanged: the text input keeps `inbox`, and the diff-only save omits `channel` |
| physical column | `varchar(255)`, because a select has no `maxLength` | `varchar(64)`, unchanged |

The objectui row is a source reading at the pin, not a browser run.

## Release reading (standing rule 甲)

No ADR-0087 conversion carries this narrowing: the narrowed set is stored data rows of a platform object, not authored metadata. What I measured matches the dispatch's first arm: new writes that name another channel are refused loudly. Stored rows are untouched by every reader and by every write that does not name `channel`:

- Reading or listing a stored `inbox` row, editing any other column, and deleting it behave as before (pinned).
- `NotificationTemplateStore.load` for `email` and for `sms` still returns nothing for a stored `inbox` row (pinned), so the row renders nowhere, as before.
- One write on a stored row is refused: a save that names the row's other channel again (pinned). That is a save naming another channel, which is what the ruling refuses.

So the narrowing ships in 18.x as a fix, and no 19.0 refusal card is owed.

The changeset is `minor`, not `patch`. `check-changeset-no-major` grades a declared `no (narrowing)` as breaking, and the launch-window convention ships it as `minor`. Measured with a simulated PR body: "direction arm: `narrowing` — a BREAKING change; during the launch window it ships `minor`". The ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, and `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` is green.

## A correction to the copy the dispatch asked for

The dispatch asked the copy to say that a notify node naming a `template` uses that email template on every channel. That is false for SMS at this commit. `sms-channel.ts` has no template path: it never reads `payload.template`, and it loads the `(topic, 'sms', locale)` row whether or not the notification names an email template. On the template path, `notify-node.ts` sets no title or body, so with no row the SMS body is the topic. The shipped copy says what is true: email and the inbox render the named email template, and SMS still uses its row.

## Tests

- **New test file.** `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-template-channel.integration.test.ts` has 13 cases on a real ObjectQL with SqlDriver over better-sqlite3.
  - Refusals: insert naming `inbox`, `push`, `webhook`, `Email` and `' sms'`; insert carrying `keptOptionValues`; by-id update; predicate update; and a save that re-names a stored row's channel. Each asserts code `VALIDATION_FAILED` and served status `400` (through `resolveThrownHttpError`), the field, and the head of the message.
  - Positive twins: `email` and `sms` are accepted.
  - Stored-row preservation: other columns can be edited, the row can be deleted, and it renders on neither channel.
- **Ablation.** The rule was made inert by replacing its pattern with `[\s\S]*` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The 9 refusal cases went red ("the write was accepted") and the 4 preservation cases stayed green. Restored blob == HEAD `629a45203037`; `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Package checks at `6c9eed45b`.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging run typecheck` exits 0, and `--listFiles` shows the new test file in the program. The suite passes: 54 files, 606 tests.
- **Import side.** The exported object narrowed, so I ran `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `phone-sms-template-organization.integration.test.ts` and `phone-sms-seed-retired.test.ts`: 7 passed (they write `sms` rows only).
- **Gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 98 commands at `6c9eed45b`, and all exit 0. Two of them first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3) and passed on re-run after a workspace build. The `--ran` reconciliation reads 98 derived, 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- **SMS ignores a notify `template`** (see the correction above). Not filed: no measured producer sends a templated notify on `sms`. HotCRM's 19 templated notify nodes use inbox and email, and the examples name no template, so there is no reach reading. Carrier: the `domain:services` seat (the #24770 family). Dedupe words: sms channel notify template ignored; payload.template sms; templated notify sms topic body.
- **A `select` spelling for this field** (a Setup dropdown) would first need the console's select widget to keep a stored out-of-set value on load. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none.
- `origin/main` moved 3 commits after this branch merged `5d27d326c` (cli, plugin-security, docs/qa). None touches this diff's files or packages.
